name: Georges Comotti
features: olive skin, dark hair combed straight back, dark eyes, broad square face, strong jaw, solid medium build, composed unhurried expression
bio: Gianfranco ‘Franco’ Comotti of Brescia, entered in French events as Georges. He first raced at the 1928 Italian Grand Prix for Scuderia Materassi, won the Naples Grand Prix in 1933, the Grand Prix du Comminges in 1934 and the RAC Tourist Trophy at Donington in 1937, and spent the last years before the war living in France driving Talbot-Lagos and Delahayes. He came back afterwards with Écurie France.
